title: Flutter / Dart Developer
job_description:
Ready To Build Something Real?

John Galt Services seeks a full-time Flutter / Dart Developer to serve a US customer building an intelligent financial advisory platform that helps consumers understand and improve their credit using agentic AI workflows, real-time streaming, and a polished mobile experience.

This is a production SaaS product with real users and real money flowing through it. The mobile app is the primary interface for consumers: financial analysis dashboards, conversational AI interactions, real-time notifications, and data visualization. It's built in Flutter/Dart, backed by a serious NestJS API.

You won't be building throwaway prototypes or pixel-pushing someone else's Figma. You'll be shipping features that real users rely on to manage their financial lives. The codebase is modern, the architecture is serious, and the problems are interesting.

You must be fluent in English. You will join our customer's development team as a remote member with real responsibilities — not busywork.

IMPORTANT!

Your application is our first test of your attention to detail and ability to follow instructions. 👀

👉 Read this ENTIRE job listing!

👉 Follow the application instructions EXACTLY!

👉 If you do not meet the minimum qualifications for the job, DO NOT APPLY!

If you fail to follow the instructions below, we will reject your application without reading it!

Minimum Job Qualifications

FLUENT SPOKEN & WRITTEN ENGLISH! You will communicate daily with a US-based team. Your English must be clear and confident — spoken and written. If you aren't sure, keep practicing and apply next time.

SOLID FLUTTER & DART SKILLS! You must have built and shipped at least one production Flutter app. You understand state management, widget lifecycle, platform channels, and how to write clean, maintainable Dart. If your apps are held together with setState spaghetti and you've never thought about architecture, keep learning and come back.

EXPERIENCE WITH REAL-TIME & API INTEGRATION! The app communicates with a NestJS back end via REST and real-time streaming (WebSockets / SSE). You should be comfortable consuming APIs, handling authentication flows (JWT), managing local state and caching, and building responsive UIs that reflect live data.

WILLINGNESS TO LEARN AND TAKE OWNERSHIP! This app integrates financial data feeds, conversational AI, and data visualizations. You won't be expected to know all of these on day one, but you'll be expected to dig in and figure things out. If you need someone looking over your shoulder at every step, this role will be frustrating for both of us.

A DISCIPLINED ENGINEERING APPROACH! You write tests. You read the requirements before you code. You don't push to main and pray. We don't expect perfection. We DO expect professionalism.

You MUST have at least a Bachelor degree.

You MUST be willing to work late night hours.

You MUST either live on Bali or be willing to relocate to Bali.

You MUST have the right to work legally in Indonesia. JGS does NOT sponsor work visas!

ATTENTION TO DETAIL! The moment we see your application, we'll know.

If you do not meet ALL of these requirements, DO NOT APPLY for this job!

Nice To Have

iOS & Android platform-specific experience

Firebase / push notifications

CI/CD for mobile (Fastlane, Codemagic, GitHub Actions)

Responsive design & accessibility

Figma-to-Flutter workflows

Git & GitHub

REST API design & consumption

State management frameworks (Riverpod, Bloc, Provider)

Working Arrangements

You are supporting our customer remotely, but this is NOT a remote job! We will provide working space and equipment near Canggu, Bali. All work is performed on-site.

Salary & Benefits

New associates start at a probationary pay scale of IDR 8 jt / month gross (i.e. before taxes & benefits). Your probationary period is three months.

If we retain you past three months, your pay will increase to IDR 12 jt / month gross.

We pay performance bonuses based on your ability to contribute. The less hand-holding you need and the less rework your code requires, the more valuable you are to the team. After your probationary period, we will pay up to a 50% bonus for any month in which you meet or exceed our expectations. This would bring your pay as high as IDR 18 jt / month gross.

We also reserve a large pool of funds for staff perks, events & annual bonuses. If we are happy with your work, you will be VERY happy with your choice!

Also, our office is just minutes from the beach, right outside Canggu, Bali. If you know, you know!

Who Is John Galt?

Good question! Might help to show up at your interview with an answer.

HOW TO APPLY 👈

Make sure your JobStreet profile includes a valid email & WhatsApp phone number.

Include this EXACT cover letter:

It must be written in fluent English, BY YOU, not by an AI assistant. We can tell! 👀

The very top line of the cover letter should contain ONLY a link to your GitHub profile. Nothing else.

Below this, describe your experience as a Flutter / Dart developer. There will be thousands of applicants for this job. Explain why we should pick YOU.

title: Senior Unity Developer
job_description:
Senior Unity Developer

(WebGL, WebGPU, AR & Cross-Platform)




About the Role

Idea Comindo is seeking an experienced and highly creative Senior Unity Developer to join our team. In this role, your primary focus will be on the presentation layer-acting as the bridge between our robust NestJS backend and the end-user. You will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing interactive frontend applications and games across multiple platforms (WebGL, WebGPU, Desktop, Mobile, and AR).

The ideal candidate is a frontend specialist who writes clean C# code and Unity Game Engine expert, excels at consuming backend data (REST/GraphQL), understands deep performance optimization, and thrives in a results-driven environment.


Key Responsibilities

• Frontend Data Integration: Connect the Unity client to our NestJS backend via REST APIs and GraphQL, ensuring seamless asynchronous data flow and real-time state updates without blocking the main thread.

• Geospatial Visualization: Translate raw geospatial coordinates and map data provided by the backend into accurate, performant 3D visual representations within the Unity environment, managing floating-point rendering challenges.

• AI State Rendering: Consume AI-driven responses from the backend to trigger dynamic visual states, UI updates, and character behaviors in real-time.

• Artwork & Animation Implementation: Integrate 3D models, textures, and UI elements. Utilize Unity's Animator, Timeline, and visual effects tools to create polished, fluid frontend experiences optimized for web and mobile.

• Cross-Platform Build & Optimization: Profile and optimize applications to ensure maximum performance, focusing on reducing draw calls, managing memory, and optimizing assets specifically for WebGL, WebGPU, and Mobile browsers.


Technical Requirements

• Core Engine: High proficiency in Unity/Unity3D and robust knowledge of C# programming.

• Platform Expertise: Proven experience building for WebGL, WebGPU, and Desktop (Windows/MacOS). Familiarity with HTML5, JavaScript, and web browser performance optimization is essential.

• AR Development: Hands-on experience with AR frameworks such as ARKit, ARCore, and Vuforia. Solid understanding of both marker-based and marker-less tracking.

• API & Data: Strong practical experience consuming REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints within Unity, including handling JSON/data serialization for frontend rendering.

• Art Pipeline: Solid understanding of the 3D art pipeline (importing FBX/OBJ, materials, shaders, lighting, rigging) and optimizing those assets for constrained platforms.

• Version Control: Proficient in using Git and standard version control workflows.


Experience & Educational Background

• Experience: Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in Unity development, with a proven portfolio of published WebGL, WebGPU, Desktop, and/or AR projects.

• Education: D3 or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.




Soft Skills

• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to designers and backend developers.

• Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Creativity: A keen eye for detail, strong visual sense, and an innovative approach to interactive experiences.

Write and maintain unit tests / basic automated tests where feasible; at a minimum, ensure robust manual test scripts for critical flows.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Proactively suggest technical improvements that reduce downtime, simplify maintenance, and improve data quality.

Strong understanding of Odoo framework: ORM, security (record rules/access rights), workflows, scheduled actions, and multi-company/multi-currency concepts.

Experience integrating Odoo with external systems via REST APIs (JSON/XML), webhooks, or middleware.

Comfortable working with PostgreSQL (basic querying, indexing awareness, understanding of Odoo schema).

Familiarity with Git and standard SDLC practices (branching, merge requests, code review, tagging).

Proven track record of troubleshooting production issues in Odoo (performance, deadlocks, broken flows) and delivering stable fixes.

Able to communicate clearly in Bahasa Indonesia and working English; able to explain technical topics in simple terms to non‑ technical colleagues.

Want To Build Interfaces People Actually Use?

John Galt Services seeks a full-time Front-End React Developer to serve a US customer building a construction project management platform used by contractors across the United States.

This is a production SaaS product with real users managing real projects: tracking leads, building proposals, scheduling jobs, managing equipment and inventory, processing invoices and purchase orders. The front end is a React + TypeScript monorepo with two apps: a full-featured CMS for internal teams and a customer-facing portal. It's built on modern tooling—Vite, Tailwind, Radix UI, TanStack Query—with a shared component library and domain-specific packages.

You won't be tweaking landing pages or building throwaway prototypes. You'll be building complex, data-rich interfaces that contractors depend on every day. The problems are real, the users are real, and the architecture is designed to scale.

You must be fluent in English. You will join our customer's development team as a remote member with real responsibilities, not pixel-pushing tickets.

👉 Follow the application instructions EXACTLY!

👉 If you do not meet the minimum qualifications for the job, DO NOT APPLY!

SOLID REACT & TYPESCRIPT SKILLS! You should be comfortable building real applications with React and TypeScript: not just following tutorials. You need to understand component composition, hooks, state management, and how to structure a codebase that won't collapse under its own mass. If your idea of state management is useState for everything, take some time to level up first.

EXPERIENCE WITH MODERN UI TOOLING! The front end is a pnpm monorepo (Turborepo) with two apps—a CMS and a customer portal—built on React + Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, React Hook Form, Zod, and TanStack React Query. You don't need to know all of these, but you should have built something real with at least a few of them. If you've never worked with a component library or a design system, this will be a steep climb.

AN EYE FOR DETAIL AND QUALITY! You will build interfaces for real users who care about things working correctly. Forms that validate properly. Tables that sort and paginate. Drag-and-drop that doesn't break. Rich text editing that produces clean output. If you think "it works on my machine" is a valid QA strategy, we're not a match.

WILLINGNESS TO LEARN AND TAKE OWNERSHIP! The codebase includes shared libraries for authentication, domain models, and UI components. You'll be expected to understand the architecture, not just drop code into it. If you need someone to hand you a Figma file for every pixel, this role will be frustrating for both of us.

title: Senior Front End Engineer

About Bukumed

Bukumed is a healthcare SaaS platform digitising the operations of medical facilities across Indonesia — from primary clinics and pharmacies to independent practices. We are not just software. We are building Indonesia's digital health infrastructure, integrated with SatuSehat, BPJS, and international FHIR standards.

We are growing fast. We are now looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who does not just know how to build interfaces — but knows how to leverage AI to move faster and think smarter.

The Role

You will be the full owner of the frontend experience at Bukumed. Not a spec executor — but a technical partner who shapes how the product feels and works for non-technical users in clinical environments.

You will work across modules: EMR, pharmacy management, billing, patient queuing, and SatuSehat integration. All real-time. All high-stakes.

What You Will Do

Product & Interface

Build UIs that are intuitive for clinic staff — including nurses, pharmacists, and admins who are not tech-savvy

Translate complex clinical workflows into simple, efficient user flows

Build and maintain the Bulan Design System (MUI + Figma-based) to keep the product consistent across all modules

AI-Augmented Engineering

Use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of your daily workflow — not a novelty

Build UI components for AI-powered features such as streaming inputs, diagnosis suggestions, and document automation

Evaluate and validate AI-generated code before it reaches production

Quality & Collaboration

Lead code reviews focused on quality, not just syntax

Collaborate directly with product, UX writing, and backend engineering (Go + PostgreSQL)

Ensure performance, accessibility, and compliance with Indonesian health data regulations (PMK, SatuSehat)

What We Are Looking For

Technical (Required)

5+ years building production-grade frontend applications

Strong React + TypeScript — hooks, state management, performance optimisation

Solid grasp of modern frontend architecture: component design patterns, code splitting, rendering strategies

Experience with REST APIs and real-time integrations (WebSocket or SSE)

Comfortable with testing: React Testing Library, Playwright, or Cypress

AI Literacy (Required)

Actively using AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow right now

Able to write effective prompts that produce accurate components and logic

Know when to trust AI output and when to write it yourself

Good to Have

Experience building UI for multi-role B2B SaaS products

Familiar with MUI, Figma-to-code workflows, or design systems

Prior experience in healthcare tech or with sensitive data environments

Experience with Next.js or other SSR frameworks

What We Are Not Looking For

Engineers who wait for perfect specs before moving

Developers who see AI coding tools as a threat rather than a tool

People who are comfortable staying only in their existing "safe zone" of technology

Our Stack

Frontend : React · TypeScript · MUI · Vite · Next.js Backend : Go · PostgreSQL · Redis Integrations : SatuSehat (FHIR) · BPJS · HL7 Infrastructure: AWS · Docker · GitHub Actions AI Tools : Claude Code · Cursor · GitHub Copilot

Interview Process

We respect your time. The process is short and relevant:

Take Home Assessment (60 min max, async) — we review code or a project you have built; no LeetCode

Phone Interview (30 min) — get to know each other; you share your experience and how you work

System Design & Live Coding (60 min) — frontend architecture discussion + one real React scenario

Culture & Team Fit — Virtual meet the product and engineering team

We will ask how you use AI in your workflow — not as a trick question, but because it is how we actually work.

What We Offer

Remote-first with full flexibility (WIB timezone overlap required)

Competitive compensation + equity as an early team member

Direct access to product decisions — your voice matters

A fast-moving environment that does not sacrifice quality

The chance to build a product used daily by Indonesian healthcare workers

Citizenship Requirement

This role is open to Indonesian citizens only. We are building a product deeply rooted in Indonesia's healthcare system — SatuSehat, BPJS, PMK regulations, and the day-to-day realities of Indonesian clinic operations. We need someone who understands this context from the inside.

How to Apply

Submit here https://forms.gle/ydWzZ9ztnzG4f9Yo9

Bukumed believes that good technology starts with engineers who care. If you want work that makes a real difference — this is it.

title: Technical Product Lead (Full-stack Software Engineer)
job_description:
TECHNICAL PRODUCT & DELIVERY LEAD
Full-stack Software Engineer Background

GeoScanning & Telecommunications Signal Analysis Platform  |  Advanced English Required

West Jakarta | Full time on site

The Role

We are seeking a Technical Product Manager to bridge the gap between technical project management and full stack engineering. You will manage the development flow and timelines and serve as the senior technical voice on facilitating architectural decisions for the ecosystem, overseeing backend, web frontend, mobile (Android)  development.  You will act as the bridge between the CTO's strategic vision and the engineering team's daily work - converting high-level direction into clear, buildable specifications that each team member can act on without guesswork.

 This role requires advanced spoken and written English.

 Company Description

Pillar Technology is a provider of advanced communications solutions and a trusted supplier of telecommunications equipment to government and law enforcement agencies across Indonesia.

We are developing a web and Android platform for geoscanning of telecommunications signals — continuously collecting RF and GPS data in the field, uploading it to a backend server, and presenting operators with live signal visualisation, parameter analysis, and identification of areas of interest. The team currently comprises five engineers: backend, frontend, UI/UX, and two Android developers, working toward a production-ready release.

Qualifications

Essential

· 5+ years in Software Engineering, technical project management with a strong foundation in full stack development, or a closely related software role.

· Deep understanding of Backend (API Design/ DB management), web (modern frameworks like React) and mobile (Native or Cross-platform)

· Proven ability to write precise, unambiguous feature specifications that developers can build from independently.

· Working knowledge of software concepts — APIs, databases, frontend/backend architecture, mobile development — sufficient to hold a technical discussion and spot spec gaps.

· Hands-on agile experience: sprint planning, backlog management, and running ceremonies for a small team.

· Experience owning a QA or acceptance testing process — writing test cases, logging bugs, and making release decisions.

· Disciplined approach to documentation — feature specs, release notes, service records, and configuration logs maintained consistently throughout the project lifecycle.

· Advanced written and spoken English — specifications are the foundation of the team's daily work (please do not apply if this requirement is not met).

Nice to Have

·       Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related technical field — preferably from a top-tier Indonesian university (ITB, UI, ITS Surabaya, Telkom University, BINUS).

·       Background in or exposure to telecommunications, RF systems, GPS data, or geospatial platforms.

·       Familiarity with Figma or wireframing tools; exposure to SQL or data analysis.

·       Experience managing requirements for Android apps involving background services or data collection.

Key Responsibilities

Project Orchestration

· Manage the end-to-end project lifecycle, defining milestones and ensuring timely delivery.

Architectural decision making:

· Select and validate the tech stack decisions across BE, FE and Mobile. Ensure architecture is scalable, secure and maintainable.

· Define technical contracts (APIs / Databases) that allow our different platforms to communicate.

· Conduct high level code review and set engineering standards.

Feature Specification

· Write detailed PRDs defining feature behaviour in full: happy path, edge cases, error states, and explicit logic rules.

· Establish a Definition of Ready — every sprint item must have complete acceptance criteria before development begins.

· Collaborate with the UI/UX designer to validate wireframes against requirements before build starts.

Sprint & Delivery Management

· Own the prioritised product backlog and run full agile ceremonies across all five engineering streams.

· Manage the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from requirements through release and post-release monitoring — ensuring each phase has clear ownership and handoff criteria.

· Track sprint delivery, surface blockers early, and manage cross-stream dependencies between backend, frontend, and Android.

· Own the release calendar, define delivery Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with the CTO, and report regularly against them.

QA & Release Sign-Off

· Own the QA process across the team — there is no dedicated QA engineer; this role fills that function.

· Conduct functional acceptance testing against the acceptance criteria you defined, before any feature is released.

· Log, prioritise, and track bugs discovered during testing back into the product backlog.

· Plan and coordinate structured User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with the CTO and end-client stakeholders; document outcomes and ensure sign-off before production releases.

· Make the go/no-go call on each release — you are the final quality gate before a build ships.

Technical Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication

· Work with engineers to understand how functional requirements affect the system — APIs, data flows, background service behaviour, upload reliability — without writing production code.

· Identify when a seemingly simple functional change carries significant engineering cost.

· Act as the first point of escalation (L2) for operational issues reported by end-clients — triage, document, and route to the appropriate engineer.

· Maintain comprehensive documentation across the full product lifecycle: system configurations, feature specs, release notes, and service records.

· Translate CTO direction into precise developer language; translate engineering constraints into clear CTO updates.

· Produce concise sprint summaries, milestone updates, and risk assessments.

What We Offer

·       Competitive full-time compensation commensurate with experience.

·       A technically complex, mission-critical platform deployed by government and law enforcement clients.

·       High-visibility role with direct access to the CTO — your judgement will be trusted and acted upon.

·       Potential for long-term involvement as the platform scales toward full production deployment.
